symptom: After upgrading to nightly-20261117, exec/diff of an unchanged script with JavaScript actions rewrote every .js stub: the action's documentation vanished from the JSDoc, the banner lost '- the import list' and gained a 'Special characters' line, optional parameters lost their [brackets], and CRLF became LF.
file: sdk/javaactions/jssource.go JSSource.Generate / completeJSImports / jsDocType / jsDocReturn / enumUnion; mdl/backend/modelsdk/javascript_write.go WriteJavaScriptSourceFile / enumerationValueNames. Goldens: sdk/javaactions/testdata/mxbuild/JS_*_11.12.6.js.golden. Tests: sdk/javaactions/jssource_mxbuild_2357_test.go
cause: mxcli's JavaScript generator never matched mxbuild's file; the files on disk were mxbuild's, and the #2131 indentation fix made each re-run's user code differ from them, so every run regenerated the file in mxcli's shape.
insight: **Measure the generator against the tool that owns the file, for every type, in one build.** mxbuild 11.12.6 --target=deploy on actions mxcli created shows: banner with '- the import list' and no 'Special characters' line, `import { Big } from "big.js";` always, the action's documentation first in the JSDoc, `[name]` for an optional parameter, Integer/Long/Decimal as Big (not number), objects MxObject, lists MxObject[], enumerations `undefined|"Red"|"Blue"`, CRLF. The old generator also mistyped Integer/Long/Decimal as number. Control after the fix: mxcli writes 10 actions, mxbuild regenerates them, all 10 files are byte-identical, and a re-run reports Unchanged.
